A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ER stress can alter the activities of transcription factors in a complex manner.
the ER stress response is not only a simple process, but is also complicated by the interactions of other signaling pathways.
ER stress affects the activity of TFs in a time dependent and drug dependent manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the TF activation array technology provides a useful tool in identifying novel TFs associated with ER stress and in understanding the complex mechanism of ER stress.
we have discovered that there is a complex and time-dependent response of TFs to ER stress.
